dedupe_keys.name: european transport feeds list of open gtfs and netex feeds in europe

description: European transport feeds is a community list of openly available public transport data feeds in Europe, meant to ease application development, research and experiments on a multinational scale. The page explains that EU member states must publish datasets on National Access Points under delegated regulation 2017/1926, but that many are hard to find or only in one language. Each feed has an original URL and a stable URL that redirects to the current endpoint, and the page notes that several states offer no official GTFS because EU rules only require NeTEx. It replaces the older European transport operators list on GitHub, whose README says it is unmaintained. Coverage: European countries, plus some neighbours. Format and access: a web list without registration. Licence and cost: free; the list's own licence is not clearly stated, and each feed has its own terms. Caveats: some notes are dated (for example German coverage as of April 2020). It supports network flow studies across borders. It relates to the French, Polish and Dutch access points and the Transmodel, NeTEx and SIRI standards in the catalogue.
